site_description: Explore Indonesia's environmental and disaster information by region.
disclaimer: Not an emergency alert service. Follow official advisories.
roadmap_summary: Code navigation, data pipelines and collection infrastructure are implemented. Verified boundaries, source approvals and production alert delivery still require review.
notification_setup: Notification permission is not an active alert subscription.
boundary_unavailable: Verified boundaries are not available yet.
boundary_explanation: Browse the historical region directory while boundary vintage and reuse rights are reviewed.
pin_storage_error: Unable to save or remove this location on this device.
permissions_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications or the required service worker.
snapshot_explanation: Snapshots are not a real-time alert service.
map_help: Scroll to zoom. Drag to move. Pinch on touch screens. Region buttons also work with a keyboard.
support_description: An independent project. Optional support helps fund hosting and data maintenance.
summary_heading: What the collected data tells us
summary_scope: Counts describe recent collected observations, not all events in Indonesia. Older records are available through protected archive downloads. Missing data does not mean no risk.
retention_note: Records are kept for up to 365 days, then automatically removed.
no_observations: More verified observations are needed before a summary can be calculated.
largest_observed: Largest recorded magnitude in this collected sample
shallow_observations: Earthquake observations shallower than 70 km in this sample
summary_window: Recent collected observations · up to 30 days
illustration_disclaimer: Illustration only. Wind, clouds and rain here are not measured conditions.
share_card_caveat: A dated snapshot; conditions may have changed. Not an emergency alert service.
share_map_unavailable: Verified map geometry is not available.
share_image_failed: Unable to draw the share image. You can still copy the public link.
share_action_failed: Sharing failed. Download the PNG or copy the public link instead.
pwa_description: Install the offline shell. Provider data still needs a connection and verified sources.
pwa_manual_install: Use your browser menu to install this app. In Safari, choose Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa_unavailable: Installation and update checks need a supported secure browser and a production build.
pwa_update_error: Unable to check or apply the update. Try again when connected.
pwa_install_requested: Installation requested. Finish the browser’s installation steps.
pwa_update_explanation: Reload when you are ready. Your saved locations stay on this device.
region_mapping_unavailable: These records have no verified region assignment. This does not mean the selected region has no events.
region_no_matches: No records in this snapshot have a verified match to the selected region.
download_protection: Cold archive downloads use Cloudflare Turnstile and rate limits. No account is required.
verification_unavailable: Archive verification is not configured. Please try again later.
archive_window: Choose up to 31 days within the retained year. Downloads open in a separate tab.
